title: An icon font is never a glyph gap: Apply gives it no faces and the built-site check does not report it
steps: Read the ok/not ok line of each test named in run.tests, and the fail count.
expect: 'an icon font is never a gap: by the pictures its file holds, or by the name an icon family goes by' is ok: with Font Awesome 6 Free (its real fa-solid-900.woff2), swiper-icons and Jost on a Vietnamese page, glyphGaps answers only Jost (it answered all three before).
'the font file of JA Essence WordPress is read: its Jost has no Vietnamese letters' stays ok.

selectors.glyphs: glyphGaps and iconFont in apps/tracy-web/src/lib/font-glyphs.js; the readiness rule lang-2-font-glyphs.js imports the same iconFont

evidence: Local stand, run j2 (14/10/2026): the built-site check reported 'font awesome 6 free', 'font awesome 6 brands', 'fontawesome' and 'swiper-icons' as unable to draw Vietnamese on JA Nova, JA Resort, JA Seven and JA Donate Joomla (FULL + design system).
fence: glyphGaps over a page and real font files from the repo. Not exercised: a running site.

tests: an icon font is never a gap: by the pictures its file holds, or by the name an icon family goes by
the font file of JA Essence WordPress is read: its Jost has no Vietnamese letters
